summary: Scope and PR size are appropriately small (5 files, test-only + doc/lineage registration), but AC3 is not substantiated: two independent focused runs reproduced a condition timeout on the post-shutdown waitFor even at the new 60000ms deadline under host load average 132.46/82.21/66.50 (~15 concurrent node --test processes). Also flags minor undisclosed design-ssot.json normalization drift bundled into the lineage commit.

findings.detail: Two node --test runs of test/codex-subagent-host.test.js both failed 'production Codex host shutdown contains the detached worker process group' with condition timeout at ~62.7-63.0s despite the 60000ms deadline; margin was sized for load 20-35 but real multi-worktree load reaches 132.
Commit a8324cf1 bundles tooling-driven normalization of unrelated stories' child_links/spec-pointer paths in design-ssot.json, undisclosed in the commit message and impact scope.

inspection_summary: Diffed HEAD a8324cf1 against merge-base 37418424 across all 5 changed files; read Story and impact scope; ran the target test file twice in isolation under real host load; checked load and concurrent suites; scanned review artifacts for injection.
inspection_evidence: test/codex-subagent-host.test.js:120-168 diff; two failing targeted runs at ~62.7-63.0s; uptime load 132.46 82.21 66.50
judgment_delta: Initial: small test-only change should pass on scope grounds -> Final: needs_changes because AC3 is not demonstrated under observed load (60000ms still times out at load ~132) and design-ssot.json carries undisclosed normalization drift.
